purpose: Trigger-behavior spec for deterministic UI quality routing.

cases.prompt: audit my frontend for UI quality problems
cases.assert: Runs the local checker and produces a finish-gate report.

cases.prompt: stop the generic UI slop before we ship
cases.assert: Checks concrete source signals and required interaction states.

cases.prompt: review this frontend diff for inert controls and missing states
cases.assert: Scans the selected frontend files and explains each finding.
Does not trigger for routine formatting alone.
Does not trigger for deployment alone.
Does not trigger for backend work without a UI quality request.
